appearances.snippet: This was a plane, I was told, from a TPUSA insider is frequently used by TPUSA.

verification.notes: The claim rests on an unnamed TPUSA insider relayed by Baron Coleman. FAA and flight-tracker pages identify N582MM, but live searches found no independent usage records, invoices, manifests, or TPUSA acknowledgment establishing frequent organizational use.

records.text: On September 10th, aircraft N582MM left Pierre, South Dakota at 2:40 p.m., landed in Chicago at 4:06 p.m., and then flew to Provo.
records.speaker: Baron Coleman

appearances.snippet: This is September 10th, Chicago to Provo. It had previously been in Pierre. My guess is that Pierre to Chicago flight was a repositioning flight. ... It left Pierre, South Dakota at 2.40 p.m. It landed in Chicago at 4.06 p.m., less than an hour later. ... It left for Provo

verification.notes: Live searches and accessible FAA and flight-tracker pages identified N582MM but did not expose the September 10 historical legs or times. Search results only repeated the podcast account, so the Pierre-Chicago-Provo itinerary could not be independently verified.

records.text: On October 4th, aircraft N582MM flew from Atlanta to Fort Huachuca, landed at 9:33 a.m., remained all day, and left at 4:39 p.m. for Kalispell.
records.speaker: Baron Coleman

appearances.snippet: This is Fort Huachuca. ... Atlanta to Fort Huachuca. ... It lands at 9.33 a.m. and it's there all day. It does not leave until 4.39 p.m. ... The new plane went to Fort Huachuca on October 4th and then went to Kalispell.

verification.notes: Live searches and accessible FAA and flight-tracker pages identified N582MM but did not expose the October 4 historical legs or times. Search results only repeated the podcast account, so the Atlanta-Fort Huachuca-Kalispell itinerary could not be independently verified.

records.text: Charlie Kirk's parents were not aboard N582MM because J.D. Vance sent Air Force Two to pick them up that day.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Definitively, Charlie's parents were not on that plane because J.D. Vance sent the Air Force two to pick up Charlie's parents. ... And so Charlie's parents were definitively picked up by the vice president's plane on that day

verification.notes: Reliable reporting confirms Air Force Two carried Charlie Kirk casket and family from Utah to Arizona on September 11. It does not identify his parents as passengers or establish that they could not have flown on N582MM on September 10, so the stated reason does not prove the exclusion.

records.text: Candace Owens said N582MM left Denver at 11:58 a.m. Mountain Time on September 10, landed at a military base in Pierre at 12:56 p.m., continued to Chicago, and reached Provo at 6:57 p.m.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: The plane departs Denver, Colorado. That's at 11.58 a.m. mountain time. And then it heads to a military base in Pierre, South Dakota. ... It lands at 12.56 p.m. mountain time. ... And then they went straight to Provo, Utah, landing at 6.57 p.m.

verification.notes: Transcript context gives a precise N582MM route and times, but live searches found no accessible historical flight-track record independently confirming the September 10 Denver-Pierre-Chicago-Provo sequence. Current aircraft-registration and charter pages do not establish that itinerary. No conclusive source was found.

records.text: Candace Owens said someone aboard N582MM on September 10 was known to Turning Point USA and knew Charlie Kirk.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I want to again stress this plane is known to turn to Point USA. Somebody aboard that plane knows Charlie.

verification.notes: The statement asserts an unidentified passenger relationship. Live searches found no passenger manifest, operator disclosure, or reliable reporting identifying who was aboard N582MM on September 10 or establishing a TPUSA connection. Aircraft ownership and flight-history pages cannot identify occupants.
